# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 21 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 21 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_021_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 21

**21:1** When it dawned on Herod that the Magi had played him for a fool, his rage erupted. He sent soldiers with a brutal command: "Kill every male child two years old and under."

**21:2** The news reached Mary: children were being slaughtered. Frantic with fear, she grabbed the baby, swaddled him tight, and hid him in a manger.

**21:3** Elizabeth got word too — soldiers were looking for John. She snatched him up and ran for the hills. Panting, terrified, she looked in every direction for somewhere to hide him. Nothing. Then she cried out to the mountain itself: "Mountain of God — open up! Shelter a mother and her child!" She was too exhausted to climb any further. And the mountain cracked open and swallowed them both inside. Light shone through the rock around them, because an angel of God was there with them, guarding them.
